title: Dynamic apples
description: Make apples properly grow on oak trees and have easy right click harvest!
body: Dynamic apples adds a simple, cozy harvest touch to Minecraft oak trees. Apples can appear hanging from natural oak leaves in varied positions, including under leaves or on exposed sides. Right-click a visible apple to pick it into your first available inventory slot, stacking with other apples when possible. If your inventory is full, the apple drops beside the leaf instead. Breaking a leaf with an apple also drops it, making oak trees feel more alive while keeping normal leaf rendering untouched.
